title: Multilingual Options for ScamShield Helpline and Outreach Materials
what_it_is: Multilingual Options for ScamShield Helpline and Outreach Materials

sections.label: Interactive Voice Response language options
sections.summary: The system will be enhanced in 2026 to let callers navigate the Interactive Voice Response System in all four official languages.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We have also received feedback from many Singaporeans, especially our seniors, who have expressed an interest who do want more language options to be supported.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: So, I am happy to announce that in 2026, we are currently working on it, and we will enhance in 2026, for the system to allow callers to navigate the Interactive Voice Response System in all four official languages.

sections.label: Police anti-scam resource guide
sections.summary: Since July, the Police have been disseminating an anti-scam resource guide in all four official languages to households.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For instance, since July, the Police have been disseminating an anti-scam resource guide in all four official languages to households.

sections.label: ScamShield advice for seniors
sections.summary: Work with the National Crime Prevention Council aims to deliver advice in 2026, referring seniors to the ScamShield website, app and helpline.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Indeed, we are working on it, in 2026, this is a suggestion that we recently discussed internally and my guidance to the team is to be earlier rather than later.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: This is an effort that we are working on in concert with the National Crime Prevention Council.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: We hope to deliver as soon as possible within 2026.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: In terms of what kind of advice we give to our seniors, I think, more importantly, I will refer them to the ScamShield suite of options.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: We have the website, we have the app as well as the helpline.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: And if indeed, they find the operator on the helpline speaking too quickly, the senior can make a request for the operator to slow down.
